info.title: Partner V1 public API
info.description: Closed public HTTP surface of the Partner integration, served by the dedicated Partner Consumer Gateway (AD-08). Partner V2 is an internal architecture replacement: clients receive no new HTTP version, authentication profile, error vocabulary or operation model.

the pipeline branch and request-authentication profile of every route

get.summary: Minimal Partner, application and owner context

200.description: Application-bound Partner context and minimal owner facts. Identity documents, security state, PIN, devices, roles, default wallet and subscription identifiers are never returned.
Confirmed wallet grants intersected with live owner eligibility. Invalid or stale grants are omitted rather than reported.
Wallet detail.
One catalogue card at the current wallet price.

post.description: Idempotent under the presented Idempotency-Key. The response that FIRST reports the order completed - the fresh 201, or the 200 that reconciles an attempt whose first response was lost - carries the credentials the sale released, under orders:create alone, and never carries Idempotency-Replayed. A later replay of that key answers with the status first reported, Idempotency-Replayed true, and the operation id, state, invoice id and the order summary (external reference, card, quantity and total) only; reading the credentials again is a reveal that needs cards:reveal. The request body is at most 8,192 bytes; a larger body is refused with validation_failed before the order is admitted.

200.description: Either of two answers to an exact repeat of the key. (1) The completion of an order whose first response was lost, reconciled from the owner: the FIRST report of that completion, so it carries the credentials the sale released and NO Idempotency-Replayed. (2) A replay of a key whose completion was first reported by such a 200: Idempotency-Replayed true, the operation id, state, invoice id and the order summary (external reference, card, quantity and total) only, and none of the credentials. A client tells them apart by the credentials, never by the status.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and true only on a replay: an answer rebuilt from the operation record for a key whose outcome was already reported. Never present on the reconciled completion that carries the credentials. Covered by the response signature.

201.description: New completed order, carrying the credentials the sale released. A replay of a key whose completion was first reported by this 201 is also a 201, with Idempotency-Replayed true, the same Location, the operation id, state, invoice id and the order summary (external reference, card, quantity and total) only, and none of the credentials.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and true only on a replay of a key first completed with 201; never on the first completion. Covered by the response signature.

202.description: Admitted but not yet terminal: the owner outcome is still running or unknown. Wait for Retry-After, then repeat the identical POST with the same Idempotency-Key. GET /v1/orders/{operationId} reports the state but never moves the order.

402.description: allowed_debt_consent_required: covering the purchase needs the account's allowed debt and the request did not consent to it (useAllowedDebt false). Nothing was charged; submit a new order with useAllowedDebt true only if debt is intended.

409.description: idempotency_conflict for a changed application, target or semantic intent under the same key; replay_detected for a reused nonce; insufficient_balance when balance plus allowed debt cannot cover the order.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests; Retry-After is present when the reset is known. daily_limit_exceeded: the owner's daily allowance is exhausted; no Retry-After is available, and the refusal is not retryable as the same order. spending_limit_exceeded: the order was not placed because it would take the application's spending above its ceiling for the current period; nothing was charged, the refusal is final for this order, and Retry-After is the number of seconds until the period ends — submit a new order with a new Idempotency-Key after it.

get.description: Reports the state of an order operation this Application owns. Requires orders:read, or orders:create, which also permits reading the Application's own operations. It dispatches nothing and never carries credentials; an operation owned by another Application is indistinguishable from an absent one.

200.description: Current operation state. A committed order never becomes failed; infrastructure uncertainty, grant removal, authoritative absence and exhausted recovery stay nonterminal.

404.description: Absent, or owned by another application. The two are intentionally indistinguishable and neither makes an owner call.

200.description: Masked projections only. Voucher and serial plaintext are never materialized on this path.
Masked detail only.

post.description: Sends no request body: any byte, including {}, is refused with validation_failed. The signature still covers the Content-Digest of the empty body.

post.summary: Reveal the credentials of an invoice
post.description: Sends no request body: any byte, including {}, is refused with validation_failed. The signature still covers the Content-Digest of the empty body.

Requires admission with non-empty effective scopes and a nonce; no specific scope, idempotency key or evidence is required. Repeats return the current stop timestamp. Inaccessible identifiers return resource_not_found. An invalid reason returns 422 validation_failed.

200.description: Signed current stop state.

post.description: Requires admission with non-empty effective scopes and a nonce; no specific scope, idempotency key or evidence is required. Repeats return the current stop timestamp. Inaccessible identifiers return resource_not_found. An invalid reason returns 422 validation_failed.

parameters.name: keyId
parameters.description: Canonical hyphenated UUID of a key belonging to the admitted application.

200.description: Signed current stop state.

post.description: Passes the normal signature, profile, source, scope and nonce pipeline, creates no SQL operation or evidence, reads no wallet and calls no owner.

requestBody.description: Exactly the two bytes '{}'. Any extra member fails before an owner or SQL operation.

200.description: Safe parsed facts only.
Safe application and invitation state only.
One-time key identifier, RFC 7638 thumbprint and domain-separated challenge. Emitted only after Runtime response evidence commits against the exact Commands enrollment Event.
The key's enrollment status after the proof: pendingApproval until Anis staff record the key's fingerprint and confirm it, then active.
Safe generation, proof, approval and expiry state. A lagging projection may be milliseconds behind and cannot authorize a mutation.

get.description: The public HTTPS bootstrap document bypasses Runtime admission. It publishes active, next and retired public signing keys with validity metadata; retired keys remain for 90 days. Enabled or disabled versions tagged compromisedAt are excluded from keys and listed in revoked for 90 days. No response signature or private material is present. A webhook-key outage keeps serving the answer keys and omits only the webhook keys (Critical log, readiness Degraded). Only an answer-key outage makes the document unavailable.

200.description: Active, next and retired public signing keys plus revoked key identifiers and compromise timestamps. No private member is ever present.

Cache-Control.description: Public cache policy for the JWK document.

get.description: Staging only — testing endpoints, not available in production. بيئة الاختبار فقط — نقاط نهاية للاختبار، غير متاحة في الإنتاج. Requires admission with non-empty effective scopes; no specific scope. Lists every network the application may call from, each marked as added by Anis or by the Partner, and how many more the Partner may add. A change made a moment ago may take a few seconds to show here; the add and remove answers carry the current list. Available only on the test environment Anis gives you; elsewhere it answers 404 resource_not_found.

200.description: The application's allowed networks.

post.description: Staging only — testing endpoints, not available in production. بيئة الاختبار فقط — نقاط نهاية للاختبار، غير متاحة في الإنتاج. Requires admission with non-empty effective scopes and a nonce; no specific scope or idempotency key. Allows one public IPv4 or IPv6 address (stored as /32 or /128) from the next request on. An address that is already allowed returns 200 with changed false. A private, loopback, link-local, shared or reserved address returns 422 validation_failed; a Partner that has added its maximum returns 409 partner_network_limit_reached. Available only on the test environment Anis gives you; elsewhere it answers 404 resource_not_found.

200.description: Signed list of the application's allowed networks after this call.

post.description: Staging only — testing endpoints, not available in production. بيئة الاختبار فقط — نقاط نهاية للاختبار، غير متاحة في الإنتاج. Requires admission with non-empty effective scopes and a nonce; no specific scope or idempotency key. Removes an address the Partner added itself; requests from it are refused from the next request on. An address that is not in the list returns 200 with changed false; an address Anis added returns 409 network_not_removable. Available only on the test environment Anis gives you; elsewhere it answers 404 resource_not_found.

200.description: Signed list of the application's allowed networks after this call.

get.description: The meter packages this wallet can buy, priced for the wallet. Requires meter_charges:read, or meter_charges:create, which also permits the reads. The wallet and its owner are proved by Cards on every call.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque stable paging cursor returned by the previous page.

200.description: A page of packages.

get.description: The calling application's own meter charges in this wallet, newest first. Without bounds the last 31 days are listed; a window is at most 31 days. Requires meter_charges:read, or meter_charges:create. It makes no Cards call and reads no receipt: use the single charge for tokens.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only charges in this state.

parameters.name: meterNumber
parameters.description: Only charges of this meter. One to 64 ASCII digits, as in a charge request; a leading zero is significant.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window, UTC, inclusive.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window, UTC.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque stable paging cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100.

200.description: A page of charge summaries.

post.description: Idempotent under the presented Idempotency-Key, which is the charge id. The charge is accepted with 202 and a body of exactly operationId, operationType and status: acceptance and any continuing uncertainty, a check with the electricity company that cannot be reached included, are NOT proof of completion. Read GET /v1/meter-charges/{operationId} or wait for the webhook for the tokens. Repeating the identical create checks the charge first: a final state answers with the charge itself (200), a running one with 202 again. Another application's id is never revealed. Requires meter_charges:create, which also permits the reads. The request body is at most 8,192 bytes.

200.description: The charge in its final state, read from Meter on a repeat of the create. The first report of the final state carries no Idempotency-Replayed; a later repeat of a closed charge answers with Idempotency-Replayed true.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and true only on a replay of a closed charge. Covered by the response signature.

202.description: Accepted and still processing, or the outcome is not decided yet. The body is exactly operationId, operationType and status. Wait for Retry-After, then read the charge or repeat the identical create.

422.description: validation_failed for a bad body, or meter_rejected when the electricity company refused the meter at the check.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests; Retry-After is present when the reset is known. spending_limit_exceeded: the charge was not accepted because it would take the application's spending above its ceiling for the current period; nothing was charged and Retry-After is the number of seconds until the period ends.

409.description: idempotency_conflict for a changed application, wallet, package, meter, total or reference under the same key, or for a duplicate id that stays unknown to this application a minute after admission; replay_detected for a reused nonce; insufficient_balance when the wallet cannot cover the charge; price_changed when expectedTotal differs from the current price; package_unavailable when the package is inactive or unknown. Recovery depends on the code. idempotency_conflict and replay_detected do not say the original request failed: it may already have been accepted and charged, so never assume nothing was charged; read the original operation with GET /v1/meter-charges/{operationId} before any new attempt. To repeat the same intent after replay_detected, keep the Idempotency-Key and send a fresh nonce and signature. After idempotency_conflict, reuse the key only for identical intent and use a new Idempotency-Key only for a genuinely new operation. insufficient_balance, price_changed and package_unavailable are refusals before any money moved: nothing was charged, and a new attempt needs a new Idempotency-Key once the balance, the price or the package choice has changed.

get.description: Reads a meter charge this application owns by its operation id (the Idempotency-Key of the create), with every token, the receipt, the failure and the refund state. Requires meter_charges:read, or meter_charges:create. Runtime proves the operation is this application's; Meter always supplies the content. A charge Meter has not projected yet answers 202 with the three-member processing body. A create that was refused and recorded as refused never produced a charge, so there is nothing to read: the recorded refusal is answered (409 or 422, with Idempotency-Replayed true) instead of 202 for ever. A failed charge is a normal 200 read. Another application's charge is indistinguishable from an absent one.

200.description: The charge in its current state.

202.description: Accepted but not visible yet: the charge is still processing. Repeat the read after Retry-After.

409.description: A refusal recorded for the create under this id, answered as the repeated create answers it, with Idempotency-Replayed true. insufficient_balance, price_changed and package_unavailable are refusals before any money moved: nothing was charged. idempotency_conflict means no charge of this application exists under this id: use a new Idempotency-Key only for a genuinely new operation.

422.description: meter_rejected: a refusal recorded for the create under this id because the electricity company refused the meter at the check; nothing was charged. Answered with Idempotency-Replayed true. validation_failed for a malformed request.

get.description: The direct recharge products and the bounds of this wallet's tier. Requires direct_recharges:read, or direct_recharges:create, which also permits the reads. A product the wallet cannot buy is listed with available false.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only products of this type.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque stable paging cursor returned by the previous page.

200.description: A page of products.

get.description: One product with the recipient fields the caller must fill. Requires direct_recharges:read, or direct_recharges:create.

200.description: The product and its recipient fields.

get.description: The values a list recipient field accepts, searchable by name. Requires direct_recharges:read, or direct_recharges:create.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Name search, at most 200 characters.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque stable paging cursor returned by the previous page.

200.description: A page of locations.

get.description: What a direct recharge would cost now, on both sides of the conversion. Nothing is reserved. Requires direct_recharges:read, or direct_recharges:create. An unavailable product, or an amount outside its bounds, is refused.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount, positive with exactly three decimals.

parameters.name: amountIn
parameters.description: fx: the amount is the payout in the product's currency. lyd: the amount is dinars.

200.description: The quote.

get.description: The calling application's own direct recharges in this wallet, newest first. Without bounds the last 31 days are listed; a window is at most 31 days. Requires direct_recharges:read, or direct_recharges:create. It makes no Cards call and shows no recipient: read the single direct recharge for that.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only direct recharges in this state.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Only direct recharges of this product.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window, UTC, inclusive.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window, UTC.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque stable paging cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100.

200.description: A page of direct recharge summaries.

post.description: Idempotent under the presented Idempotency-Key, which is the operation id. The direct recharge is accepted with 202 and a body of exactly operationId, operationType and status: acceptance and any continuing uncertainty are NOT proof of payment or delivery. Read GET /v1/direct-recharges/{operationId} or wait for the webhook. Repeating the identical create checks the direct recharge first: a final state answers with the direct recharge itself (200), a running one with 202 again. The recipient may be sent in any order; changing any value under the same key is an idempotency conflict. Requires direct_recharges:create, which also permits every direct recharge read. The request body is at most 8,192 bytes.

200.description: The direct recharge in its final state, read again on a repeat of the create. The first report of the final state carries no Idempotency-Replayed; a later repeat of a closed one answers with Idempotency-Replayed true.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and true only on a replay of a closed direct recharge. Covered by the response signature.

202.description: Accepted and still processing, or the outcome is not decided yet. The body is exactly operationId, operationType and status. Wait for Retry-After, then read the direct recharge or repeat the identical create.

422.description: validation_failed for a bad body, or a recipient the owner refused, in which case extensions.fields maps each recipient key to a safe rule message; amount_out_of_range when the payout or total is outside the product's limits.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests; Retry-After is present when the reset is known. spending_limit_exceeded: the direct recharge was not accepted because it would take the application's spending above its ceiling for the current period; nothing was charged and Retry-After is the number of seconds until the period ends.

409.description: idempotency_conflict for a changed application, wallet, product, amounts, recipient, note or reference under the same key, or for a duplicate id that stays unknown to this application a minute after admission; replay_detected for a reused nonce; insufficient_balance when the wallet cannot cover the total; price_changed when the quote moved; direct_recharge_product_unavailable when the product is unavailable, Fazaa-only for this wallet or has no price for its tier. Recovery depends on the code. idempotency_conflict and replay_detected do not say the original request failed: it may already have been accepted and charged, so never assume nothing was charged; read the original operation with GET /v1/direct-recharges/{operationId} before any new attempt. To repeat the same intent after replay_detected, keep the Idempotency-Key and send a fresh nonce and signature. After idempotency_conflict, reuse the key only for identical intent and use a new Idempotency-Key only for a genuinely new operation. insufficient_balance, price_changed and direct_recharge_product_unavailable are refusals before any money moved: nothing was charged, and a new attempt needs a new Idempotency-Key once the balance, the quote or the product choice has changed.

get.description: Reads a direct recharge this application owns by its operation id (the Idempotency-Key of the create), with its recipient, amounts, state and proof. Requires direct_recharges:read, or direct_recharges:create. Anis proves the operation is this application's and a direct recharge, and always reads the content itself. A direct recharge that is not visible yet answers 202 with the three-member processing body. A create that was refused and recorded as refused never produced a direct recharge, so there is nothing to read: the recorded refusal is answered (409 or 422, with Idempotency-Replayed true) instead of 202 for ever. A failed or rejected state is a normal 200 read. Another application's direct recharge is indistinguishable from an absent one.

200.description: The direct recharge in its current state.

202.description: Accepted but not visible yet: still processing. Repeat the read after Retry-After.

409.description: A refusal recorded for the create under this id, answered as the repeated create answers it, with Idempotency-Replayed true. insufficient_balance, price_changed and direct_recharge_product_unavailable are refusals before any money moved: nothing was charged. idempotency_conflict means no direct recharge of this application exists under this id: use a new Idempotency-Key only for a genuinely new operation.

422.description: amount_out_of_range or a recipient the owner refused: a refusal recorded for the create under this id, answered with Idempotency-Replayed true; nothing was charged. validation_failed for a malformed request.

patch.summary: Correct the recipient of a paused direct recharge
patch.description: Allowed only while the status is suspendedDataError. The recipient list REPLACES the stored one. The signed request is retained as evidence; a correction whose evidence cannot be recorded is refused before it is applied. Requires direct_recharges:create. A successful command answers signed 202 with only operationId, operationType=directRecharge and status=processing. The Location header points to /v1/direct-recharges/{operationId}. Acceptance is confirmed while the read side catches up; read the direct recharge or wait for a directRecharge.* webhook. Read before retrying, because an unchanged retry of an applied correction is refused with direct_recharge_not_suspended. Another application's direct recharge answers like an absent one. The request body is at most 8,192 bytes.

202.description: The correction was accepted. The signed acknowledgement contains only operationId, operationType=directRecharge and status=processing. Location points to GET /v1/direct-recharges/{operationId}; read it or wait for a directRecharge.* webhook before retrying.

422.description: validation_failed for a bad body, or a recipient the owner refused, in which case extensions.fields maps each recipient key to a safe rule message.

409.description: direct_recharge_not_suspended when the direct recharge is not paused for a recipient correction (read it first: an unchanged correction that already applied is refused this way); replay_detected for a reused nonce.

get.description: The application's webhook endpoint and its state. No scope is required: every application manages its own endpoint.

200.description: The endpoint, or notConfigured with null url and generation.

put.description: Sets the one HTTPS endpoint. A changed URL starts a new registration: the service sends a verification challenge the endpoint must echo within 10 seconds, and only then is it verified. The same URL keeps its verification and registration number, including when staff disabled it. The answer is Commands' own, not the read side's, so it is current. No scope is required. The body is at most 8,192 bytes.

200.description: The endpoint after the change.

422.description: webhook_endpoint_invalid when the URL breaks the endpoint rules; validation_failed for a malformed body.

post.description: Queues a test delivery to the verified, enabled endpoint. The body is the empty object. The answer says the delivery is queued, never that the endpoint received it: read the delivery list. A repeated call within one request is deduplicated by the service. No scope is required.

409.description: webhook_endpoint_unverified when the endpoint is not set, not verified or disabled; replay_detected for a reused nonce.

get.description: The application's webhook deliveries, newest first, 50 per page. since includes events that occurred at it. The cursor freezes which events a traversal contains, not their changing statuses. Verification deliveries are not listed. No scope is required.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only deliveries in this state.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only events that occurred at or after this UTC instant.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

200.description: A page of deliveries.

post.description: Queues a failed delivery again with its original id and body. Only a failed, retained event of this application can be redelivered; another application's event answers like an absent one. The endpoint must be verified and enabled. The body is the empty object. No scope is required.

422.description: validation_failed when the event is not failed or is already queued, or the request is malformed.

409.description: webhook_endpoint_unverified when the endpoint is not set, not verified or disabled; replay_detected for a reused nonce.

partnerMessageSignature.name: Signature
partnerMessageSignature.description: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature over the exact covered components for the route's profile, using P-256 ECDSA with SHA-256 and IEEE P1363 fixed-field encoding, accompanied by Signature-Input. No alternate algorithm, profile, component order or parameter form is accepted.

enrollmentToken.description: Authorization: Enrollment {token}. At least 256 bits of entropy, valid until the invitation expires (default 24 hours), stored only as SHA-256 and never logged. Once the public key is submitted, the possession proof must follow before the challenge expires (default 30 minutes).

WalletId.name: walletId
WalletId.description: Canonical wallet UUID; must intersect the confirmed wallet grants.

OperationId.name: operationId
OperationId.description: The public Idempotency-Key of the originating order; also the global operation identifier.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque stable paging cursor returned by the previous page.

SignatureInput.name: Signature-Input
SignatureInput.description: sig1=(...);created=...;expires=...;keyid="...";alg="ecdsa-p256-sha256". created may be at most 30 seconds ahead of Anis's clock and at most 300 seconds old when the request arrives; expires, if present, must not have passed. Sign each attempt afresh and keep expires at most 60 seconds after created (the Anis SDKs use 60).

Signature.name: Signature
Signature.description: sig1=:base64:. P-256/SHA-256 in IEEE P1363 encoding; DER is rejected.

ContentDigest.name: Content-Digest
ContentDigest.description: RFC 9530 sha-256=:base64:. Exactly one member; compared in fixed time against the transmitted bytes before any Redis, SQL, model-binding or owner work.

Nonce.name: Nonce
Nonce.description: Fresh per mutation. Reserved with SET NX PX and a 600 second TTL; replay returns 409.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Canonical UUID equal to the global operation identifier. The same key with changed application, target or semantic intent is a conflict.

AnisDate.name: X-Anis-Date
AnisDate.description: Covered by every request signature profile.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Presentation preference only; never drives authorization or client branching.

EventId.name: eventId
EventId.description: Canonical UUID of a webhook event of this application.

XRequestId.description: Correlation identifier; covered by the response signature.

ContentDigest.description: RFC 9530 digest over the exact emitted response bytes.

SignatureInput.description: Covered components of the response signature. The base block is "@status" "content-digest" "x-request-id" "signature-input";req, in that order; the ';req' request binding parameter is mandatory, so a captured response never verifies against a different request. Semantic profiles append Location, Retry-After, Idempotency-Replayed and cache/no-store headers where the route emits them.

Signature.description: Response signature. Clients discard unverifiable responses.

Location.description: Operation location; covered by the response signature.

RetryAfter.description: Positive delay, present only for known-reset refusals and processing responses; covered by the response signature.

CacheControl.description: no-store on security-sensitive responses; covered by the response signature.

Problem.description: Signed RFC 9457 problem from the closed public catalogue. An unmapped private code becomes a signed and evidenced 500 internal_error with critical telemetry.

BadRequest.description: malformed_signed_request. The signed request is malformed or does not match its body: a missing Signature or Signature-Input header, components signed in another order, an unparseable signature or Content-Digest, or a Content-Digest that does not match the body. It says nothing about the key, the application or the account.

Unauthorized.description: invalid_credentials on the signed routes, invitation_invalid on the enrolment routes. On the signed routes an unknown key, a key or application that is not active, and a signature that does not verify or is outside its validity window are externally indistinguishable.

Forbidden.description: insufficient_scope, source_ip_not_allowed, binding_not_authorized, account_inactive or purchase_not_allowed.

NotFound.description: Absent or inaccessible existence-sensitive resource; a wallet outside the confirmed grants is non-discovering.

Conflict.description: State, idempotency or owner business conflict, including nonce replay.

UnprocessableRequestModel.description: Semantically invalid request model. An invalid order model after authentication discards the pending token and makes zero Runtime SQL or owner calls.

RateLimited.description: Rate or limit refusal. Known-reset emitters include an exact signed Retry-After; unknown-reset emitters omit it.

DependencyUnavailable.description: A required security, state or owner dependency is unavailable. Commands and Queries failure collapses to this representation.

CatalogueCollection.description: Owner Catalogue V1 collection mapped one to one, with stable paging. Its item members are enumerated in CatalogueObject; each route answers with one of the three shapes.

CatalogueObject.description: Owner Catalogue V1 object mapped one to one. Its members are enumerated in CatalogueObject: the subcategory read answers with a subcategory.

RevealedCredential.description: One credential. Built only inside the protected response buffer, signed, evidenced and only then emitted.

RevealedCredentialCollection.description: One to one hundred credentials in deterministic SoldCard.Id order, all or nothing.

BadRequestUnsigned.description: malformed_signed_request. The signed request is malformed or does not match its body: a missing Signature or Signature-Input header, components signed in another order, an unparseable signature or Content-Digest, or a Content-Digest that does not match the body. It says nothing about the key, the application or the account.

UnauthorizedUnsigned.description: invalid_credentials on the signed routes, invitation_invalid on the enrolment routes. On the signed routes an unknown key, a key or application that is not active, and a signature that does not verify or is outside its validity window are externally indistinguishable.

ForbiddenUnsigned.description: insufficient_scope, source_ip_not_allowed, binding_not_authorized, account_inactive or purchase_not_allowed.

RateLimitedUnsigned.description: Rate or limit refusal. Known-reset emitters include an exact signed Retry-After; unknown-reset emitters omit it.

DependencyUnavailableUnsigned.description: A required security, state or owner dependency is unavailable. Commands and Queries failure collapses to this representation.

ProblemUnsigned.description: Signed RFC 9457 problem from the closed public catalogue. An unmapped private code becomes a signed and evidenced 500 internal_error with critical telemetry.

UnprocessableRequestModelUnsigned.description: Semantically invalid request model. An invalid order model after authentication discards the pending token and makes zero Runtime SQL or owner calls.

NotFoundUnsigned.description: Absent or inaccessible existence-sensitive resource; a wallet outside the confirmed grants is non-discovering.

CatalogueCollectionUnsigned.description: Owner Catalogue V1 collection mapped one to one, with stable paging. Its item members are enumerated in CatalogueObject; each route answers with one of the three shapes.

CatalogueObjectUnsigned.description: Owner Catalogue V1 object mapped one to one. Its members are enumerated in CatalogueObject: the subcategory read answers with a subcategory.

MeterPackagesConflictUnsigned.description: The wallet cannot buy right now: wallet_disabled when it is disabled, wallet_expired when it has expired, business_subscription_required when a business subscription is needed.

DirectRechargeQuoteConflictUnsigned.description: direct_recharge_product_unavailable: the product cannot be bought for this wallet (not available, no price for the wallet, or a price that is not for partners).

reason.description: Required free-text reason; trimmed before validation and forwarding.

Uuid.description: Canonical 36-character hyphenated UUID. The braced, parenthesised and 32-digit forms are rejected. Hexadecimal case is not significant on input -- the value is parsed and compared as a UUID, so two spellings cannot become two resources -- and responses emit lower case.

Money.description: Decimal string plus currency. Never a JSON number, and never a double round trip.

amount.description: Decimal string with scale exactly 3. Negative only for a wallet balance while the wallet uses allowed debt; prices and totals are always greater than zero.

LocalizedText.description: Owner-supplied Arabic and English names. The Gateway invents no fallback. Empty languages are omitted; an object with no nonempty language is omitted.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem. code and documented extension members are the machine contract; title and detail are localized presentation and must not drive client branching. Problems never carry database, stack, endpoint, signature base, digest, nonce, token, challenge, key, voucher or serial detail, nor another Partner's identity.

extensions.description: The one structured extension a problem may carry: fields, on a validation_failed answer to a direct recharge whose recipient the owner refused. It maps each submitted recipient key (or request field name) to the owner's safe rule message. Absent on every other problem.

Profile.description: Identifiers only. AD-40 and F-1: the Partner and Application are named by id and by the scopes the current policy grants, never by a display name, and never by a deployment. Nothing this host can call carries a Partner or Application name, and after AD-45 there is no environment in the claims to read.

Wallet.description: Subscription identifiers, enabled and expiry projections, capabilities and allowed debt are deliberately absent.

CatalogueObject.description: One published Catalogue V1 object. The catalogue routes return three shapes and each route returns exactly one of them: the categories list returns categories, the category-subcategories list and the subcategory read return subcategories, and the subcategory-cards list returns cards. The Gateway reimplements no region, location, limited-group, Omega, Google, Almadar, stock, feature or pricing rule; every member below is copied from the owner projection that evaluated them, and the owner cost members are deliberately absent (AD-39).

logo.description: Absolute URL composed by Cards. Absent when the owner record carries no logo.

type.description: The published category kind, as the owner's closed vocabulary spells it.

inStock.description: Any active subcategory under it currently holds an unowned purchased card.

CatalogueSubcategory.description: A published catalogue subcategory. Description and disclaimer are present on collection and detail projections when the owner supplies text.

categoryType.description: The kind of the category it belongs to, as CatalogueCategory.type spells it.

disclaimer.description: The owner's current disclaimer text for this subcategory, not a snapshot of what applied at any sale. Present on both the collection and the detail projection; omitted when the owner holds no text in either language.

logo.description: Absolute URL composed by Cards. A card carries no logo of its own and is published under this one.

available.description: Live availability under the current owner predicates for this wallet.

CatalogueCard.description: A purchasable catalogue card and the price THIS wallet pays for it. The four price members are read off the one owner PriceInfo this wallet's business pricing produced; none is re-derived here, because a second pricing calculation would be a second authority on what a card costs.

available.description: Live availability under the current owner predicates for this wallet.

logo.description: Absolute URL of the subcategory logo; omitted when absent.

type.description: The category kind, as CatalogueCategory.type spells it.

CreateOrderRequest.description: Closed DTO. Unknown members are rejected. The total must equal unit times quantity computed without floating point. Order prices also follow Runtime canonical input limits: no leading zeros and at most 15 integer digits.

Order.description: A Partner order. operationId and status are on every answer. Every answer that Runtime holds the order intent for - the fresh 201, the reconciled 200, the withheld answers, a replay, GET /v1/orders/{operationId} and the 202 - also carries externalReference (when the order sent one), cardId and quantity from that intent. total is on every answer whose status is completed: Cards' total on the first answer, the expected total of the intent on a replay or a read (an exact price match makes it the charged total), and absent while the order is processing or failed. walletId, completedAt and soldCards belong to the first answer that reports completion; a replay or a read never carries soldCards. failureCode is on GET /v1/orders/{operationId} only, when status is failed. codesWithheld is true only on the first answer to a paid order whose credentials Cards withheld; it is never false and is absent on a replay or a read.

status.description: Only a definitive owner business refusal is failed.

cardId.description: The ordered card. Present on every answer.

quantity.description: The ordered quantity. Present on every answer.

total.description: The charged total. Present on every answer whose status is completed, absent otherwise.

externalReference.description: The Partner's own reference from the order request, returned exactly as sent. Present on every answer when the order carried one.

failureCode.description: Only on GET /v1/orders/{operationId} when status is failed: the public refusal code recorded for the order, one of the codes in the error catalogue. Omitted when the recorded refusal has no public code. A replay of a failed order is a problem response and carries no body member.

codesWithheld.description: true only on the answer that first reports a paid order whose credentials could not be released. The order is placed and final: do not buy it again. A reveal of the withheld credentials is refused as well; the Partner contacts Anis support with the operation id. Never false: absent on every other answer, and on a replay or a read it means not stated.

soldCards.description: The credentials the sale released. Present on the response that FIRST reports completed - the fresh 201 and the reconciled 200 - and on no other. A replay of a terminal idempotency key returns the order without credentials, and GET /v1/orders/{operationId} reports state and the order summary only. Reading them again is a reveal and needs cards:reveal.

MaskedCard.description: Serial and voucher plaintext are never present on a masked projection. Member order follows the property list; serialNumberMasked is deliberately omitted because the owner exposes no safe mask.

invoiceId.description: Owner invoice the sold card belongs to. Documented at PCGW-05 because it is the only way a Partner learns an invoice identifier, and the invoice reveal route is unreachable without one.

invoiceNumber.description: The invoice's own number, as printed on it; invoiceId is the identifier the reveal route takes.

credentialAvailable.description: True when a reveal of this card would release a code. A refunded or invalid card, or one with no code, reads false. Never a credential and never reveals how long one is.

unitPrice.description: The price paid for this card in the wallet currency, as sold. A later refund does not change it.

expiryDate.description: The card's own expiry date, yyyy-MM-dd. Omitted when the card has none.

RevealedCredential.description: The only representation that carries credential plaintext. It exists solely inside the protected response buffer and never reaches Runtime, logs, traces, metrics or error metadata. Reveals and the first completed order answer share the full projection in the listed member order.

expiryDate.description: The card's own expiry date, yyyy-MM-dd. Present wherever the card has one, including inside an order's soldCards.

invoiceId.description: The invoice the sold card belongs to, including inside order soldCards.

purchasedAt.description: When the card was sold, including inside order soldCards.

SignatureDiagnostic.description: Safe parsed facts about the presented signature. Never the signature base, signature value, digest, nonce or key material.

routeId.description: The catalogued route the request matched, as in x-anis-route.routeId.

authority.description: The canonical public authority the request arrived on, exactly as signed.

canonicalQuery.description: The query string with no leading '?'. Empty when the request carried none.

requiredScope.description: Empty for a route that requires no scope.

coveredComponents.description: The exact ordered components the route's request signature must cover.

receivedAt.description: When the trusted ingress received the request.

EnrollmentState.description: Safe application and invitation state only.

PublicJwk.description: Strict public JWK. A private d member is rejected at the Gateway and again by Commands, which is the authority.

safetyCode.description: The 16-character safety code derived from your key's fingerprint. Anis staff will phone your technical contact and ask you to read it before your key goes live.

signature.description: base64url IEEE P1363 signature over the exact UTF-8 proof text.

EnrollmentStatus.description: Safe generation, proof, approval and expiry state. After a successful proof the key stays pendingApproval until Anis staff record its fingerprint and confirm it; state is then active and approvalState approved.

expiresAt.description: Deadline of the current enrolment step: the invitation window while it is still open. Absent otherwise, and always absent once the key is active or unavailable.

keyExpiresAt.description: The key's own end date: after it, every signed call made with this key is refused. Present once the key is active; absent before. Not the same as expiresAt, which is the deadline of the current enrolment step.

PublishedSigningKey.description: Response-only P-256 signing key and validity metadata. Compromised versions are excluded. Keys of both purposes are published in one document; each purpose has its own key name, so a rotation or a compromise of one never touches the other.

retiredAt.description: Present only for retired keys. Earlier of the vault expiry and the successor notBefore; the key is listed only while now < retiredAt + 90 days.

purpose.description: What the key verifies: answer for a response signature (Signature-Input keyid names this kid), webhook for a webhook delivery signature. Additive: a client that does not know the member ignores it. Optional for compatibility with existing clients; the service always emits it.

compromisedAt.description: RFC 3339 compromisedAt version tag, retained while now < compromisedAt + 90 days. Reject this kid regardless of signature creation time.

CardSummary.description: Product metadata shared by masked cards, revealed credentials and order soldCards. Member order is id, name, faceValue, logo, subcategory, category; empty strings and localized text are omitted.

address.description: One public IPv4 or IPv6 address, without a prefix length.

cidr.description: The allowed network in CIDR form; an address the Partner added is a /32 (IPv4) or /128 (IPv6).

addedBy.description: Who added it. Only networks the Partner added can be removed through this API.

networks.description: Every network the application may call from, in canonical order.

partnerNetworksRemaining.description: How many more addresses the Partner may add.

changed.description: False when the address was already allowed (add) or already absent (remove).

networks.description: Every network the application may call from, in canonical order.

partnerNetworksRemaining.description: How many more addresses the Partner may add.

MeterRefundStatus.description: refunded: the money is back. notCharged: the wallet refused, so nothing was taken. pending: the refund has not landed yet and staff are alerted.

MeterPackage.description: A meter package priced for THIS wallet. unitPrice is what the wallet pays and personalPrice is the retail price; businessPrice appears only when the app would show it for the wallet's account. name is the package's single stored name; meter packages have no Arabic and English pair.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, or null on the last page. Send it back unchanged.

MeterToken.description: One token the electricity company issued, in its order. Tokens are not masked: a token works only on the meter that was charged. Sequence gaps, labels and codes are the electricity company's own.

MeterTax.description: A tax or fee line exactly as the electricity company states it: its Arabic account description and its amount at its own scale.

MeterReceipt.description: What the electricity company issued for a succeeded charge. creditedAmount and the tax amounts keep the scale it reported and are not forced to three decimals.

MeterFailure.description: Why the charge failed. code is a value of this body, never a problem code: a failed charge is still a normal 200 read.

amount.description: Present when money was taken (refunded or pending) and absent when nothing was charged.

MeterCharge.description: One meter charge of the calling application. total and personalPrice are frozen when the charge begins and appear in every state. completedAt belongs to a succeeded charge only; receipt to a succeeded charge; failure and refund to a failed one.

MeterChargeSummary.description: One row of the charge list: only what is needed to find a charge. Read the single charge for the receipt, tokens, failure and refund.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, or null on the last page. Send it back unchanged.

MeterPackagesQuery.description: Flattened query parameters of the package read.

MeterChargesQuery.description: Flattened query parameters of the charge list. Unknown, repeated and empty parameters are refused with validation_failed.

CreateMeterChargeRequest.description: Charges one meter. The wallet is the route's. The Idempotency-Key header is the charge id. expectedTotal is the total the caller confirmed; the current payable price is resolved and a difference is refused with price_changed. The body is at most 8,192 bytes.

meterNumber.description: Digits only, leading zeros kept. The electricity company decides whether it is a valid meter.

DirectRechargeCurrency.description: A product's payout currency by display name. These currencies have no ISO code, so none is invented.

DirectRechargePayout.description: An amount paid out in a product's own currency. Not Money: the currency is a name.

DirectRechargeLimits.description: The bounds of one product for this wallet's tier. Present only when the tier has a price for the product; a bound the owner does not hold is absent.

DirectRechargeRecipientField.description: One value the caller must supply for the recipient. A list field takes its values from the product's locations.

validation.description: A regular expression the value must match.

DirectRechargeProductSummary.description: One product row of the wallet's list. It names no recipient field.

available.description: False when the product is Fazaa-only for this wallet or has no price for the wallet's tier. The product is still listed.

DirectRechargeProduct.description: A product with the recipient fields the caller must fill, in the owner's order.

available.description: False when the product is Fazaa-only for this wallet or has no price for the wallet's tier. The product is still listed.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, or null on the last page. Send it back unchanged.
Opaque cursor of the next page, or null on the last page. Send it back unchanged.

DirectRechargeQuote.description: A price check; nothing is reserved. total is what would leave the wallet: the price with the commission.

exchangeRate.description: Decimal string with at least six decimals.

DirectRechargeProductsQuery.description: Flattened query parameters of the product list.

DirectRechargeLocationsQuery.description: Flattened query parameters of the location list.

DirectRechargeQuoteQuery.description: Flattened query parameters of a quote. Both are required.

amountIn.description: fx: the amount is the payout in the product's currency. lyd: the amount is dinars.

DirectRechargeStatus.description: awaitingPayment: recorded, money being taken. paymentFailed: the wallet refused; nothing taken (final). pending: paid, waiting for an officer. inProgress: an officer is working on it. suspendedDataError: paused because the recipient data is wrong; use the recipient route. completed: delivered (final). rejectedAwaitingRefund: rejected, refund on its way. rejectedWithRefund: rejected and the money is back (final).

DirectRechargeRecipientInput.description: One recipient value, exactly as signed: nothing is trimmed, folded or normalized, because the recipient digest is taken over these characters.

key.description: A product recipient field key. No equals sign and no control character.

valueName.description: The display name of a list field's chosen value; absent for every other field.

DirectRechargePartialRefund.description: The settled partial refund, present only once one has settled. Partial refunds occur only if partial refunds are enabled for the product.

CreateDirectRechargeRequest.description: Buys one direct recharge. The wallet is the route's. The Idempotency-Key header is the operation id. The caller never sends a price, commission or fee: the price is quoted again and compared with payoutAmount and expectedTotal. The body is at most 8,192 bytes.

payoutAmount.description: Positive, scale 3, in the product's payout currency.

recipient.description: Keys are unique ignoring case. Their order does not matter.

DirectRecharge.description: One direct recharge of the calling application. reason explains a suspension or a rejection only; completedAt is the true UTC delivery time; proofUrl is the officer's uploaded transfer proof, unchanged.

DirectRechargeSummary.description: One row of the list: the original payout and total as recorded. No recipient, note, price, commission, rate, proof or reason.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, or null on the last page. Send it back unchanged.

DirectRechargesQuery.description: Flattened query parameters of the list. Unknown, repeated and empty parameters are refused with validation_failed.

UpdateDirectRechargeRecipientRequest.description: A FULL replacement of the recipient, never a merge by key. The body is at most 8,192 bytes.

recipient.description: Keys are unique ignoring case. Their order does not matter.

WebhookEndpointStatus.description: disabled wins over verified: a disabled endpoint receives nothing, whatever it proved before.

WebhookEndpoint.description: The application's one webhook endpoint. All three members are always present; an application with no endpoint reads url null, status notConfigured and generation null. generation is the registration number of the current URL: it changes when the URL does and not otherwise.

SetWebhookEndpointRequest.description: Sets the endpoint. The URL is kept exactly as signed.

url.description: https, port 443 (implied or explicit), a host NAME and not an IP literal, no user-info, no fragment, no whitespace, control character or backslash. The host name must contain a dot: https://hooks.example.com is accepted and https://hooks is refused with webhook_endpoint_invalid. A query is allowed.

WebhookEvent.description: One delivery. attempts is the number of times an HTTP request was actually started. There is no payload, response excerpt or attempt history here.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, or null on the last page. Send it back unchanged.

WebhookEventAccepted.description: A test delivery or redelivery was queued. Nothing says the endpoint received it; read the delivery list. type is present on a test delivery and omitted on a redelivery.

WebhookEventsQuery.description: Flattened query parameters of the delivery list. Unknown, repeated and empty parameters are refused with validation_failed. There is no page size.
